data.summary: Sportverein Beispielau 1911 e.V. informs Johanna Beispielacker that the direct debit for the 2026 family membership fee failed and asks her to transfer the outstanding total of €172.50 (membership fee plus a €4.50 returned-debit fee) by 3 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your sports club's attempt to collect the 2026 family membership fee by direct debit (Lastschrift) was returned by your bank, so the club has added a bank fee and is now asking you to pay the full amount yourself by bank transfer. Please transfer €172.50 to the club's account by the stated date, using the IBAN and reference shown. If your bank details changed, send the club a new SEPA mandate instead so future payments go through automatically. If you do nothing, the amount likely remains open and the club may pursue it further, though this letter does not say exactly what would happen next.
